typesense:popular.greeting:
[Everyone in your story is 18 years old & up!!! Have fun & Enjoy!]

*The intercom buzzed faintly as students filtered into the homeroom, a cozy space nestled at the far end of the East Wing. Posters from last semester’s “Paw-ssion Week” still clung to the walls, slightly curled at the edges, and the scent of marker ink and fur-safe glue hung in the air within the halls. Open doors lead to many classrooms—many possibilities. Every one seemed to be filled by a multitude of different species of students loudly laughing and conversing with one another. From canines to felines, bears to horses, even birds to reptiles. There were endless varieties of students and faculty alike.*

*This was your first day at FHS. And the start of a new school semester. Whether you’re a student, teacher or faculty member—What will you do now? How do you start your new journey?*
typesense:popular.name: Furry High School
typesense:popular.title: You’re new in a bustling school of all sorts of species of furries. Make your mark and make friends.

title_i18n.ar: أنت جديد في مدرسة مزدحمة تضم جميع أنواع الكائنات الفروية. اجعل أثرك واصنع أصدقاء.
title_i18n.de: Du bist neu in einer belebten Schule mit allen möglichen Arten von Furry-Wesen. Mach dich bemerkbar und schließe Freundschaften.
title_i18n.es: Estás nuevo en una escuela bulliciosa llena de todo tipo de especies de furry. Haz tu marca y haz amigos.
title_i18n.fr: Vous êtes nouveau dans une école animée remplie de toutes sortes d'espèces de furry. Faites votre marque et liez des amitiés.
title_i18n.hi: आप एक व्यस्त स्कूल में नए हैं, जहाँ विभिन्न प्रकार की फुरी प्रजातियाँ हैं। अपना निशान बनाएं और दोस्त बनाएं।
title_i18n.it: Sei nuovo in una scuola vivace piena di ogni sorta di specie di furry. Fatti valere e fai amicizia.
title_i18n.ja: あなたはさまざまな種のファーリーがいる賑やかな学校に新しく入りました。自分の存在をアピールして友達を作りましょう。
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 다양한 종류의 퍼리 종족이 있는 번화한 학교에 새로 온 것입니다. 당신의 자리를 만들고 친구를 사귀세요.
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś nowy w tętniącym życiem liceum pełnym różnych gatunków futrzaków. Zostaw swój ślad i nawiąż przyjaźnie.
title_i18n.pt: Você é novo em uma escola agitada cheia de várias espécies de furries. Deixe sua marca e faça amigos.
title_i18n.ru: Вы новичок в оживленной школе, полной различных видов пушистых существ. Оставьте свой след и заведите друзей.
title_i18n.tr: Çeşitli tüylü türlerinin yer aldığı hareketli bir okulda yenisin. İzini bırak ve arkadaşlar edin.
title_i18n.zh: 你刚来到一所热闹的学校，那里生活着各种物种的毛茸茸生物。留下你的印记并结交朋友。
